scope: Align SPU Files with FM2612 and preserve paused PSF playback after Capture to Synth.

behavior.files: FILES heading with compact New JS / Save sound, one project root, flat file rows, Rename / Delete below the tree; menu imports and exports unchanged.
behavior.capture: Capture retains the same paused song position, entry and selected channel, switches Live Off, and lets keyboard notes audition the captured instrument. Resume continues the original song. Live On restores the same frozen frame before Resume.
behavior.ordinaryEdits: Actual instrument edits, another instrument load and Code start still stop the song.
behavior.failure: Preflight cancellation and insufficient editor RAM preserve the paused source and existing instrument.

safety.method: Every headless destination connection is intercepted before application scripts and routed through gain 0; Chromium additionally uses --mute-audio.

checks: Capture requires Pause and Live; reference key is explicit and defaults to C4
Changing CH during readonly preflight cancels Capture and preserves the paused song and editor
Resume during readonly preflight cancels Capture before any Stop or editor write
Genuine Capture copies original ADPCM, loops, ADSR and sends, keeps editor reverb, and never starts a note
Keyboard C5 reproduces the captured raw PITCH through the real SPU, upstream of gain zero
Save to presets and exported SPU JSON preserve bytes and tuning; repeated Capture reuses immutable sample RAM
Normal preset import stops Code temporary RAM ownership before resolving cached sample IDs
Noise-only Capture ignores zero PITCH/start and preserves clock, ADSR, voice/send and editor reverb
Actual editor RAM exhaustion fails preflight without stopping the paused PSF or replacing its instrument
